description: 冻结 DURA 与大容量直接恢复器，以源接收机均衡和源干净信号逐条融合比例监督训练门控，训练后按固定七景独立评分。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU0 FP32 deterministic source training; CPU ground two threads

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: source paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA/direct context; source receiver used only for training loss weighting
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 17632 legal L_s/U_s IDs excluding direct parent 32768 fit IDs, fixed 672 source pilot and RX4/6/8 day3

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: 32-record legal source checkpoint smoke; no source-based checkpoint selection

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1 and F-free direct final20, fresh 354785-parameter signal gate
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same legal Phase1 source role/physical split; source direct parent F-free and final20; 17632 gate fit IDs disjoint from parent 32768 and 672 pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only direct checkpoint with exact verified source fit; gate learns from legal parent-unseen L_s/U_s IQ
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20 regardless of source or target result

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0: >=4096 MiB free and fewer than 3 total compute apps; preserve other owners; at most one task worker
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only for source contract/role mismatch, nonfinite computation, incorrect checkpoint, target leakage or unrecoverable technical failure. Preserve all artifacts.

rows.purpose: Learn per-record mixture from source paired IQ with equal receiver weight and source-only oracle alpha auxiliary loss
rows.seed_notes: Gate model 2026110828; source fit 2026110611 inherited parent; order 2026110829; fixed evaluation 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: 354785 trainable gate; frozen 15558434 direct and 266951 DURA; 17632 source IDs x3 views x20 epochs, batch128

notes: Source L_s/U_s RX may weight training; no TX labels, F weights/outputs, V or target for G training. No RX or clean used at inference.
Equal total weight per source receiver; normalized IQ MSE + 0.02 DURA-change penalty + 0.02 squared source-only clipped oracle alpha error. Source clean used only in training.
17632 parent-unseen source IDs, epochs 21/22/23 fixed, 20 epochs, final only; no target feedback or checkpoint selection.
Seven focused tests and one independent P0/P1 review passed; real source no-query smoke is first step; all seven Phase1 predictions precede truth-side score.
Motivation from previously explored 672-record source pilot; resulting test is not an independent blind study.
